subject: executor: Avoid too many concurrent atomic update in probe collision (#55165)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent in HashJoinV2 probe path. Change replaces per-collision `atomic.AddInt64` on shared runtime stats with a per-JoinProbe `probeCollision` counter, reset at probe init and aggregated after all join workers finish (`workerWg.Wait()`), which preserves stats semantics while removing hot-loop contention. Verified each `ProbeWorkerV2` owns an independent `JoinProbe` (no concurrent access), and upstream/master retains the same approach (no later fix indicating a correctness regression).
